participant_1.name: Mark
participant_1.personality: Reflective and somewhat reserved, with a touch of humor. He values his role as a father and has a creative side as a recording engineer.
participant_1.background: I live in California but the recording artist market was dead last year. I am a recording engineer and own my own studio. I prefer being inside. What's up, I am a 46-year-old single dad with kids. My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer.

participant_2.name: Emily
participant_2.personality: Playful and imaginative, she enjoys singing and playing games with friends. She's enthusiastic about childhood activities and has a vivid imagination.
participant_2.background: I love to sing songs from the movie Frozen. I play with my friends on the playground. I'm in the third grade. I love to go to Disney World every year.
